newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha soars due to crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha soars due to crude gains.

text.p: Naphtha prices soared on Monday, tracking sharp crude gains in Tokyo business hours, traders said.

Open-spec naphtha for second-half October was assessed bid at $197.50 and offered at $200.00, compared with late Friday's $196.00/$196.50. First-half November was quoted at the same level as the second-half October. On Friday, second-half November was exchanged hands at $195.40.
In spreads, second-half October/second-half November was bid at even, and offered at plus 75 cents. The one month spread from first-half November was assessed at plus 50 cents/$1.50.
